import redis
r = redis.Redis.from_url('redis://redis:6379/0')
keys = r.keys('rate:*')
for k in keys:
    r.delete(k)
print(f'Deleted {len(keys)} rate keys total')
# Also delete any other potential rate limiting keys
more = r.keys('*limit*') + r.keys('*rate*')
for k in more:
    if k not in keys:
        r.delete(k)
        print(f'  extra: {k}')
PYEOF
